## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Product / privacy checks

- [ ] No raw chat text, assistant text, composer drafts, attachment text, names, emails, or API keys are persisted.
- [ ] No new network/server dependency was added.
- [ ] Browser permissions were not broadened unnecessarily.
- [ ] User-visible UI does not claim exact token counts, percentages, official quotas, or exact limits.
- [ ] Changes remain within the current `chatgpt.com` long-conversation warning scope, or the product baseline was intentionally updated.
